items.headline: Bahasa Indonesia is the primary spoken language · English widely used in business
items.detail: Standard Indonesian is the working language in government and business. Betawi dialect surfaces in casual/local contexts. English is common in international business districts (SCBD, Sudirman).

items.headline: Five administrative cities · North/South/East/West/Central Jakarta plus Kepulauan Seribu
items.detail: Kota administratif: Jakarta Pusat (Central · government) · Jakarta Selatan (South · business/expat) · Jakarta Barat (West) · Jakarta Utara (North · port) · Jakarta Timur (East). Kepulauan Seribu is the offshore islands regency.

items.headline: TransJakarta BRT + MRT Jakarta + KRL Commuterline + LRT Jakarta + ojek
items.detail: TransJakarta = bus rapid transit (widest network). MRT Jakarta = North-South metro (Lebak Bulus ↔ HI). KRL Commuterline = suburban rail. LRT Jakarta = light rail (Kelapa Gading area). Gojek + Grab ojek/car for last-mile.

items.headline: Fibre + 4G/5G widely available · IIX in Jakarta · Palapa Ring backbone
items.detail: IndiHome + Biznet + MyRepublic + First Media offer consumer fibre. IIX (Indonesian Internet Exchange) is in Jakarta. Palapa Ring provides national backbone. 4G nationwide · 5G in select districts.

items.headline: Underestimating traffic · Jakarta traffic can add 60-90 minutes to any journey
items.detail: Rush hours (07:00-10:00 and 17:00-20:00) turn short distances into hours. Recommendation: buffer generously or use MRT/KRL where corridors exist.

overall_freshness_note: Compiled 2026-09 from Wikipedia + observed common patterns · re-verify transport + prices quarterly

items.headline: Bahasa Indonesia primary · Balinese widely spoken · English strong in tourism areas
items.detail: Bahasa Bali (Balinese language) is spoken alongside Indonesian in daily life. Ubud, Kuta, Seminyak, Canggu have very high English penetration due to tourism.

items.headline: Denpasar capital + Ubud + South Bali (Kuta/Seminyak/Canggu) + Uluwatu + Sanur + North Bali (Lovina)
items.detail: Denpasar is administrative + local commerce. Ubud is central cultural heart. South Bali is tourism/beach. Uluwatu is cliff/temple. Sanur is quieter east-coast. North coast (Lovina) is less developed.

items.headline: Motorbike (ojek/self-rent) dominant · Grab/Gojek in tourist zones · limited public transport
items.detail: Motorbike rental is common (~Rp 60-100k/day). Grab and Gojek work in tourist areas but taxi mafia disputes exist in some districts. No comprehensive public transit outside Denpasar.

items.headline: Peak seasons: July-August + Christmas/New Year · dry season April-October
items.detail: Tourism concentrates around Kuta/Seminyak/Canggu (beach + party) · Ubud (yoga + culture) · Uluwatu (surf) · Nusa islands (day trips). Digital-nomad concentration in Canggu.

overall_freshness_note: Compiled 2026-09 · dynamic tourism info · re-verify seasonally
